subject: [PATCH v3] mm/memory: refuse to map page cache folios that are not uptodate

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch does not handle the case where a page cache folio is being mapped while it's still locked, and requested to wait for more reviews before applying.
reviews.raw_body:
Thanks!

I'll wait a bit for more review brefore applying.

Reviewed-by: David Hildenbrand (Arm) <david@kernel.org>

-- 
Cheers,

David

2026-11-12.patch_summary: This patch prevents mapping page cache folios that are not up-to-date, which can leak stale memory to userspace. It adds a new function `file_folio_not_uptodate` to check if a folio is uptodate and refuses the mapping in `__do_fault` and `do_set_pmd`. The fault gets a SIGBUS signal for non-uptodate folios, and MADV_COLLAPSE fails and leaves the range to be faulted in. This patch addresses a problem where some filesystems clear PG_uptodate on cached folios, which is considered buggy.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand
reviews.summary: Reviewer David Hildenbrand applied the patch and requested that any outstanding bugs be reported, so they can either drop the patch series or decide how to fix it up.
